remarks: Welcome to your cozy retreat in the heart of Byram! This adorable 1 bedroom, 1 full bath apartment on the 2nd floor offers comfort and convenience.Step into the bright living space, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen is equipped with newer appliances and plenty of storage space. The bedroom is a peaceful haven with a spacious walk-in closet. The full bath features a relaxing tub and shower.Located in a well-maintained building with laundry facilities and parking available. Explore the charming neighborhood with shops and eateries nearby.
